root_cause.text: The event ring index field was incorrectly defined with the old identifier `ERINDEX` instead of the new `CH_ERINDEX` in the IPA v5.0+ `CH_C_CNTXT_1` register fmask array, causing the field to never be programmed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `[ERINDEX]` to `[CH_ERINDEX]` in `reg_ch_c_cntxt_1_fmask[]` (drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c). The CVE description confirms that for IPA v5.0+ the event ring index moved from `CH_C_CNTXT_0` to `CH_C_CNTXT_1`, and the v5.0 register definition mistakenly used the old identifier `ERINDEX`, leading to no valid event ring and causing hangs in `gsi_channel_trans_quiesce()`.
